stem:
The scatterplot and table show the weekly profit in dollars earned from the sale of pastries at seven different prices. The data can be modeled by a quadratic function.

Which function best models the data?
visual_elements: Scatterplot titled Pastry Sales with x-axis labeled Price (dollars) ranging approx. 2.00 to 3.75 and y-axis labeled Weekly Profit (dollars) ranging approx. 100 to 170, showing 7 data points
